pwa_fix_verification.root_cause: firebase.js was registering a second service worker (firebase-messaging-sw.js) at the same scope '/' as the main PWA service worker, replacing it. The firebase SW had no fetch handler, so Chrome didn't consider the app installable.
solution_implemented: 1. Merged Firebase Messaging logic (importScripts + onBackgroundMessage + notificationclick) into service-worker.js
2. firebase.js now uses navigator.serviceWorker.ready instead of register('/firebase-messaging-sw.js')
3. firebase-messaging-sw.js converted to self-unregister script for legacy clients
